title: Control all your smart lights, plugs, and thermostats with one Alexa+ voice command
facebook: Tired of jumping up to adjust the lights, thermostat, and fans every time you want to relax? With Alexa+, you can group all your smart devices into one voice command—so saying 'movie night' dims the lights, warms the room, and turns on the fan automatically. Here's how to set it up in minutes. https://aiworldhq.com/article/control-all-your-smart-lights-plugs-and-thermostats-with-one-alexa-com #SmartHome #Alexa
